data.headline: Healthcare Implementation & Education | Project Management | Elevating Patient Care through Innovative Technology
data.about:
I am committed to driving patient-centered care through innovative technology solutions. Throughout my career, I have honed the ability to transform insights into actionable strategies, propelling product evolution and fostering growth in dynamic environments.  

During my tenure at Explorer Surgical, I excelled in numerous roles spanning customer success and operations to training and instructional design. I cultivated enduring customer relationships, spearheaded cross-functional collaborations, and delivered impactful solutions. By curating immersive training programs, I bridged the divide between intricate technologies and user-friendly adoption, igniting engagement and bolstering end-user confidence. My contributions played vital role in company growth and impact, leading to the company’s successful acquisition by GHX in October 2021. 

My dedication to patient-centered care extends to advocacy for patient-engagement initiatives centered on building trust within the healthcare continuum, strengthening connections between patients, caregivers, providers, and the ecosystem at large.

description.text:
Brainstems is an artificial intelligence platform enabling secure data sharing across various industries.

- Leading the implementation of community engagement strategy to drive audience excitement and product adoption pre-launch
- Researched and evaluated project management tools for Agile compatibility and scalability across organization workstreams

Recruited by former CEO of Explorer Surgical to support early stages of development of Flow Medical, a medical device startup developing innovative solutions to improve interventional pulmonary embolism treatment.

I have worked on a variety of projects contributing to the company's success in developing innovative solutions for interventional pulmonary embolism treatment. I have researched FDA approval processes and drafted submission documents, managed grant application projects, investigated and reported on product development options, and contributed to initial testing.

I was an early employee at Explorer Surgical, a Chicago-based company providing a digital software solution to enhance healthcare collaboration. During my 5+ year tenure, I played a pivotal role in the company's growth from Series A funding to its successful acquisition by GHX in 2021.

- Led implementation of digital case support technology at 13 hospital sites, accelerating procedural learning curves and product expansion up to 92%
- Created and delivered customized training materials for major medical device companies, resulting in a 4X ROI increase and approximately $500,000 in cost savings
- Conducted tailored training sessions, achieving a 25% increase in user adoption within the first week of onboarding
- Developed and implemented training strategies for diverse users such as team members, clients, and new hires
- Provided comprehensive support for product implementation and facilitated cross-functional collaboration to optimize efficiency

- Streamlined onboarding, enabling rapid and thorough proficiency in software functions and workflows for new employees 
- Designed and maintained a 40+ article knowledge base, boosting troubleshooting efficiency and reducing customer support demands 
- Overhauled onboarding methods, cutting training time by 66% and improving consistency

- Partnered with surgical teams to create customized procedural playbooks, enhancing intraoperative efficiency and reducing case duration and costs
- Delivered extensive customer support, achieving a 90%+ satisfaction rate across domestic and international users
- Analyzed intraoperative data, identifying inefficiencies and developing solutions to reduce avoidable costs by over $10K in per case

Researching and developing new strategies for forming a healthcare system that is built on engagement, trust, and transparency where all parties involved are heard and have a respected voice. Has involved learning from members of both the patient and caregiver community and from researchers, policy leaders, and physicians.

PXE International is focused on promoting research, increasing awareness, and supporting individuals affected by pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE). As both a research organization and advocacy group, PXE International works intimately with individuals and families affected by pseudoxanthoma elasticum to ensure that basic and clinical research goals reflect the needs and questions of those living with PXE. 

My primary focus during my time as a research program assistant was on investigating the progression and impacting factors involved in vision loss or impairment caused by advancing pseudoxanthoma elasticum. I analyzed countless medical ophthalmology records of affected individuals in search of patterns, trends in treatment methods and success, and any other information that could bolster current understanding of the disease.

experiences.subtitle: Grady Health System . undefined
experiences.caption: Sep 2016 - May 2017 · 8 mos

description.text:
My experience in the medical and surgical intensive care units of Grady Memorial Hospital included working directly with the families of patients, observing care protocol for traumatic injuries, and helping organize medical information and supplies in every unit. 

Working in the units, I maintained a constant supply of gloves, gowns, masks, and other personal protective equipment (PPE) in each medical cart, prepared and reviewed patient charts at the beginning of each shift, and observed the medical procedures used for car-crash survivors, gun-shot victims, and a vast array of other traumatic injuries. While working at the front entrance to the ICU department, I checked individuals in and out, guided visitors through the hallways to their loved ones, and helped ensure that everyone in the ICU felt safe, comfortable, and confident in the medical care performed.

Genetic Alliance is a nonprofit organization focused on engaging individuals, families, and communities to transform health and create new and secure ways to share health information and records with providers to ease clinical participation, catalyze research, and build solutions in health services. BioTrust focuses on creating an environment and relationship between researchers and participants that relies and is centered upon trust. BioTrust strives to create policies and provides novel tools for participants to actively engage in research.

Neurology lab focused on dementia and Alzheimer's Disease. Worked with aggregated alpha-synuclein, a protein thought to cause Parkinson's Disease, through immunoglobulin Elisa assays. Additionally, focused on analysis of beta-glucosidase enzyme activity involved in Gaucher's Disease through a series of BCA assays. Have developed proficiency in completing protein assays, analyzing complex lab data, and basic laboratory procedures.
